paragraphs.text: Hey, I heard you joined the reading club. Is it fun? Yes! We meet in Room 203 every Friday after class. What do you do there? We read short stories and talk about them. You should come with me next Friday. Great idea! Should I bring anything? Just yourself, and a book you like.

transcript:
— Hey, I heard you joined the reading club. Is it fun?
— Yes! We meet in Room 203 every Friday after class.
— What do you do there?
— We read short stories and talk about them. You should come with me next Friday.
— Great idea! Should I bring anything?
— Just yourself, and a book you like.
